segments.name: Clean Energy HRS & CETY Europe
segments.description: Converts wasted thermal energy from industrial facilities into zero emission electricity using Organic Rankine Cycle systems.
segments.evidence: Clean Energy HRS & CETY Europe – Our Waste Heat Recovery Solutions, converting thermal energy to zero emission electricity.

segments.name: CETY Renewables Waste to Energy Solutions
segments.description: Provides waste to energy technologies and solutions converting waste into electricity, renewable natural gas, hydrogen and biochar.
segments.evidence: CETY Renewables Waste to Energy Solutions – Providing Waste to Energy technologies and solutions.

segments.name: Engineering and Manufacturing Business
segments.description: Provides customers with comprehensive design, manufacturing, power generation, battery storage and project management solutions.
segments.evidence: Engineering and Manufacturing Business – providing customers with comprehensive design, manufacturing, power generation, BESS, and project management solutions.

segments.name: CETY HK
segments.description: Parent company of natural gas trading operations in China supplying natural gas to industrial customers and municipalities.
segments.evidence: CETY HK – The parent company of our NG trading operations in China.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for clean energy products, turnkey power plants, engineering and EPC services, and natural gas sold at daily spot prices.
revenueModel.evidence: CETY HK procures NG in bulk from wholesale suppliers at fixed, prepaid prices, typically at a discount to prevailing market rates, and sells to customers at daily spot prices over the contract term.

changes.text: In 2022 the Company added the CETY HK segment to reflect its new businesses in China.
changes.evidence: Prior to the first quarter of 2022 the Company had three reportable segments but added the CETY HK segment to reflect its recent new businesses in China.

changes.text: In December 2025 the Company disposed of its equity interest in Shuya, ending CETY HK operations through Shuya.
changes.evidence: CETY HK no longer conducts any operations through Shuya, following the disposition of the Company's equity interest in Shuya in December 2025.
